summary: Fix SSH errors from mounted /etc/ssh paths by making the volume owned by root and exposing e.g. /ssh_config:/etc/ssh/ssh_config.d/:O in Paths to expose to isolated jobs (O works only for directories); enable Expose host paths for Container Groups for HostPath mounts.
questions: SSH error when exposing /etc/ssh/ssh_config.d to jobs
What does the :O mount option do in Paths to expose to isolated jobs?
How do I mount host paths into container group pods?
Should I mount /etc into an execution environment?

answer_card.title: Expose SSH config to jobs
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Make the mounted volume owned by `root`.
2. Settings > Automation Execution > Job > Edit, and set *Paths to expose to isolated jobs*:
   ```
   ["/ssh_config:/etc/ssh/ssh_config.d/:O"]
   ```
   (`:O` is for directories only; avoid mounting `/etc` or `/usr`.)
3. For container groups, list paths like `"/mnt2:/mnt2"` and turn on *Expose host paths for Container Groups* to get HostPath volumes.
